summary: lib/graph: the shared geometry behind Diagram and Network, with no dependency. Layered (longest-path ranks, four barycentre sweeps, a deterministic order), tree, radial and seeded force layouts; adjacency, hop distances, shortest path; fit, zoom-at-point and ensure-visible for a viewport; nearest-node-in-direction for arrow keys; edges that land on a box's frame or stop 26px short of a circle, with the sheets' l-8-4v8Z head. Every layout is deterministic for the same input and seed, and an empty graph lays out to nothing. Our own code rather than dagre, d3-hierarchy or d3-force: the needs are narrow, determinism and SSR size hints are easier to guarantee, and check:boundaries keeps the door open if a library is ever warranted.
